title: POSLUMA PET Imaging for PI-RADS 3 Prostate Lesions
official: Targeting the Gray Zone: Early Detection of Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer in PI-RADS 3 Patients Using PET Imaging With an 18F-Labeled Radiohybrid PSMA-Targeted Imaging Agent
summary: This prospective, multicenter diagnostic accuracy study will evaluate whether POSLUMA (flotufolastat F 18) PET/MRI or PET/CT can detect clinically significant prostate cancer, defined as Gleason score 7 or higher, in adult men with PI-RADS 3 lesions on recent multiparametric MRI and a clinical indication for prostate biopsy. Participants will undergo a research-only POSLUMA PET scan before targeted and systematic prostate biopsy. PET imaging metrics and clinical variables will be compared with histopathology. Research PET results will not be used to guide clinical management or replace standard diagnostic procedures.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male, age 18 years or older
* PI-RADS 3 lesion diagnosed by multiparametric MRI within the past 4 weeks
* Clinical indication for prostate biopsy
* Undergoing targeted biopsy and systematic biopsy as part of the routine clinical pathway
* Able to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior diagnosis or treatment of prostate cancer
* PI-RADS 4 or 5 lesion
* Negative MRI, defined as PI-RADS 1 or 2
* Contraindication to PSMA PET or prostate biopsy
* Contraindication to both MRI and CT
* Any medical condition that may interfere with study procedures
